title: Hope remains without compulsory reassurance

captions.physics: Revealing an enlarged promise lacks confirmation

meaning: You can reveal that an enlarged promise lacks confirmation and keep honest conversation possible, acknowledging attachment to words whose repetition starts to feel necessary.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Tower in the physical position reveals a promise expanded beyond what was said. The Star in energy supports the possibility of further honest conversation without a predetermined result. The Devil in emotions describes attachment to wanted words and a sense of depending on their repetition. You can hope for interest while noticing one phrase becoming a condition of calm. That feeling does not establish an obligation for the other person to restore its earlier meaning.

For example, after “Your story interests me”, you expect unchanging approval of its continuation. A new critical response reveals that no such promise existed. Earlier certainty loses its basis. **Hope for interest does not require unchanging words of approval**. You discuss what appealed and where disagreement arose. A strong wish may remain to recover familiar reassurance, as though every trace of interest would otherwise disappear. Conversation allows room for this wish without making it proof of indifference or an obligation to praise every following section.

Difficulty grows if every sign of openness is taken to mean the wanted praise will eventually follow enough explanation. Conversation quietly becomes bargaining for the old phrase. Constructive Star energy supports hope for a genuine answer while preserving uncertainty about its content. You can value continuing interest and hear different assessments; the possibility of further conversation does not promise complete reassurance through identical confirmation after every doubt.
